top_choice_rationale: P001 gives Buchwald and Hartwig a general, ligand-controlled palladium C-N cross-coupling citation: a clear principle backed by quantitative mechanistic work (oxidative addition, amine binding, reductive elimination), three decades of independent confirmation, and the cleanest two-name attribution on the slate, with Kosugi's stoichiometric tin-amide reaction a precursor outside the citation. P002 ranks next because it contains the same part but adds Liu alone for base editing, which is a shaky allocation (Komor, Gaudelli, Kondo and Nishida are left out) and dilutes a clean prize. P003 (condensates) is a real organising principle, but in vivo relevance is still disputed and Pappu and Mittag are omitted. No award is last, since a mature, well-attributed discovery is available.
